A '''Special Zealot''' is a [[Mob]] that has a chance to spawn when the Player kills a {{MobSprite|Zealot}} or {{MobSprite|Zealot Bruiser}}. 

== Spawning ==
When a Player kills a normal {{MobSprite|Zealot}}, there is a base {{Chance|0.2381%|1|420}} chance for a '''Special Zealot''' to spawn nearby.

When a '''Special Zealot''' spawns, the Player who contributed to its spawn will hear a Wither sound effect and the following chat message:
{{Dialogue|&aA special &5Zealot &ahas spawned nearby!}}

==== Increasing Spawn Chances ====
Multiple factors can increase the chance of a '''Special Zealot''' spawning:
<!--*If the Zealot takes more than 1 hit before dying, the chance of a Special Zealot spawning is increased by about 11.1%.
*After {{Green|420}} Zealots (or {{Green|378}} Zealots if the Zealot took more than 1 hit to kill) are killed without a Special Zealot spawning, the spawn chance doubles. 
*The {{Legendary}} {{Item|Enderman Pet}} at Level 100 will also increase the odds by {{Green|25%}}.
*The [[Essence Shop#Zealuck|Zealuck]] Dragon [[Essence Shop]] perk increases the chance for a Special Zealot to spawn by {{Green|2-10%}}.
*{{Stat|Tracking}} further increases the chance for Special Zealots to spawn (for example, {{Stat|Tracking|5}} is a {{Green|5%}} increase).-->

{{Stub}}
A '''Special Zealot''' spawns neutral, only attacking the Player if attacked first or if a Player looks at their head.

If there was no place in the Player's inventory for the {{Item|Summoning Eye}}, the {{Item|Summoning Eye}} will be put in their [[Item Stash]].

The Player who contributed to the spawn of the '''Special Zealot''' will always get the {{Item|Summoning Eye}} once the '''Special Zealot''' dies, even if another player killed it. However only the killer receives the shard.

== Trivia ==
